Queue CUSIPs 69562K100/69562K506 belong to predecessor/history and are retained as identity-chain noise; they do not make the decision-period type uncertain.

SEC Schedule 13G evidence identifies PS International Group CUSIP G7308J113 as Ordinary Shares, par value US$0.0008 per share. The pre-split G7308J105 and post-split G7308J113 sequence is an ordinary-share episode.
cases.identity_chain_analysis: G0R45S109 is the AIB Acquisition Corp. predecessor identifier from before the completed business-combination episode. The PS International ordinary shares use G7308J105 before the October 2025 reverse split and G7308J113 afterward. The queue mixes predecessor and post-combination identifiers, but the authoritative legal classes are ordinary shares throughout the tracked canonical episode.
cases.contradiction_search: Searched PS International/AIB and all listed CUSIPs for preference/preferred shares, warrants, rights, units, trusts and partnership interests. SPAC-related instruments existed generally, but no authoritative evidence tied the canonical PSIG tracked security to a non-common instrument; the cited sources explicitly identify the tracked classes as ordinary shares.

factual_findings: SEC evidence identifies Bionomics Limited CUSIP 09063M205 as Ordinary Shares and explains that the CUSIP applies to its Nasdaq-quoted ADSs.

Citi depositary records identify the Bionomics ADS program as representing ordinary shares and document the exchange/termination into Neuphoria Therapeutics common stock CUSIP 64136E102 in December 2024.
SEC evidence identifies Neuphoria Therapeutics CUSIP 64136E102 as Common Stock.
The legal form changes from an ADS on ordinary shares to direct corporate common stock, but both forms are classified common under the contract policy.
cases.identity_chain_analysis: The canonical episode spans the Bionomics ADS period and the December 2024 Bionomics/Neuphoria transaction. CUSIP 09063M205 is the ADS identifier backed by ordinary shares; 64136E102 is Neuphoria common stock after the exchange. Q1521J108 is retained as a predecessor/security-master identity anomaly and is not needed to infer legal type because SEC and depositary records directly establish the tracked legal forms across the interval.
cases.contradiction_search: Searched Bionomics/Neuphoria, the listed identifiers, depositary records and SEC filings for preferred, preference ADS, warrant, right, unit, trust and partnership evidence. No contrary legal class was established for the tracked security; the authoritative records establish ordinary-share ADSs followed by common stock.
